h1.en: Electric 30 vs Diesel 30 Concrete Pump: 30 kW beside the Synchronous motor article
h1.zh: 电动30和柴油30混凝土泵是同一台吗：对照「同步電動機」时，30 kW仍在原页

directAnswer.en: Electric 30 and Diesel 30 are different concrete pumps from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Electric 30 lists a 30 kW motor, 12–15 m³/h and two stone-distance rows. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Synchronous_motor.
directAnswer.zh: 电动30和柴油30是河北品锦机械在邢台的两台不同混凝土泵。电动30标出 30 kW 电机、12–15 m³/h 和两行石子距离。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Synchronous_motor。

body.en: Image from the source page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Synchronous_motor. The picture shows Single phase low power synchronous clock motor with removed cover. Electric 30 and Diesel 30 are different concrete pumps from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Theoretical output: Electric 30 lists 12–15 m³/h. Diesel 30 lists 15 m³/h. The same shown value on a shared label: Max. outlet pressure is 20 MPa on both pages. Hopper capacity is 0.3 m³ on both pages. Diesel 30 lists entries that Electric 30 does not: Diesel engine power 4105 / 56 kW. Pumping distance (H / V) 60 m / 180 m. Hebei Pinjin Machinery builds these concrete pumps in Xingtai, Hebei.
body.zh: 图来自来源页：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Synchronous_motor。画面是Single phase low power synchronous clock motor with removed cover。电动30和柴油30是河北品锦机械在邢台的两台不同混凝土泵。最大骨料粒径：电动30标出 ≤ 3 cm；柴油30标出 3 cm and below。以上是河北品锦机械在邢台混凝土泵页面上写出的格子，不是把一台机器换算成另一台。看电动30请打开 /zh/products/electric-30-concrete-pump/，看柴油30请打开 /zh/products/diesel-30-concrete-pump/。

body.en: Electric 30 lists a 30 kW motor, 12–15 m³/h and two stone-distance rows. Max. aggregate size: Electric 30 lists ≤ 3 cm. Diesel 30 lists 3 cm and below. These are shown entries on the Hebei Pinjin Machinery pages for concrete pumps made in Xingtai. A blank or missing label is not filled from the other concrete pump. The number in a commercial name is not a licence to copy output, pressure or distance.
body.zh: 电动30标出 30 kW 电机、12–15 m³/h 和两行石子距离。外形尺寸：电动30标出 3300 × 1500 × 1500 mm；柴油30标出 4000 × 1500 × 1800 mm。电动30有、柴油30没有的行：电机功率 30 kW；细石输送（水平/垂直） 60 m / 180 m；13骨料输送（水平/垂直） 20 m / 60 m。商品名里的数字不能用来抄产量、压力或距离。

body.en: Diesel 30 lists engine 4105 / 56 kW, 15 m³/h, outlet pressure 20 MPa and one distance pair, 60 m / 180 m. Dimensions: Electric 30 lists 3300 × 1500 × 1500 mm. Diesel 30 lists 4000 × 1500 × 1800 mm. They are not a calculated conversion from one model to the other. Match the power line first: motor kilowatts on one page, an engine code on the other. If a job needs a figure this pair does not list, use the contact page rather than inventing a bore, stroke or price.
body.zh: 柴油30标出发动机 4105 / 56 kW、15 m³/h、出口压力 20 MPa，以及一组距离 60 m / 180 m。整机重量：电动30标出 1200 kg；柴油30标出 2000 kg。柴油30有、电动30没有的行：柴油机功率 4105 / 56 kW；输送距离（水平/垂直） 60 m / 180 m。如果工况需要这对机型没有写出的数字，请走联系页，不要编造缸径、行程或价格。

body.en: The catalogue does not treat the numeral 30 as theoretical output. Main unit weight: Electric 30 lists 1200 kg. Diesel 30 lists 2000 kg. Electric 30 lists entries that Diesel 30 does not: Motor power 30 kW. Fine-stone pumping (H / V) 60 m / 180 m. Aggregate-13 pumping (H / V) 20 m / 60 m. Open /en/products/electric-30-concrete-pump/ for Electric 30 and /en/products/diesel-30-concrete-pump/ for Diesel 30.
body.zh: 理论输送量：电动30标出 12–15 m³/h；柴油30标出 15 m³/h。同一标题下数值相同的有：最大出口压力两边都是 20 MPa；料斗容积两边都是 0.3 m³。先看动力行：一页是电机千瓦，另一页是发动机代号。

question.en: Does Electric 30 list the same theoretical output as Diesel 30?
question.zh: 电动30和柴油30的理论输送量一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 30 lists 12–15 m³/h. Diesel 30 lists 15 m³/h. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue entries from Xingtai, and neither entry replaces the other. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Synchronous_motor.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动30标出 12–15 m³/h。柴油30标出 15 m³/h。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Synchronous_motor画面里印出的数字。

question.en: Does Electric 30 list the same max. aggregate size as Diesel 30?
question.zh: 电动30和柴油30的最大骨料粒径一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 30 lists ≤ 3 cm. Diesel 30 lists 3 cm and below. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue entries from Xingtai, and neither entry replaces the other. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Synchronous_motor.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动30标出 ≤ 3 cm。柴油30标出 3 cm and below。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Synchronous_motor画面里印出的数字。

question.en: Does Electric 30 list the same dimensions as Diesel 30?
question.zh: 电动30和柴油30的外形尺寸一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 30 lists 3300 × 1500 × 1500 mm. Diesel 30 lists 4000 × 1500 × 1800 mm. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue entries from Xingtai, and neither entry replaces the other. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Synchronous_motor.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动30标出 3300 × 1500 × 1500 mm。柴油30标出 4000 × 1500 × 1800 mm。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Synchronous_motor画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: Why is motor power missing on Diesel 30?
question.zh: 为什么柴油30没有电机功率？

answer.en: The Diesel 30 page does not list that label. Electric 30 lists 30 kW. Leave the missing entry blank. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not publish a rule for copying it across concrete pumps. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Synchronous_motor.
answer.zh: 柴油30这一页没有标出这个标题。电动30标出的是 30 kW。缺的格子保持空白。河北品锦机械没有公布把该格抄到另一台混凝土泵上的规则。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Synchronous_motor画面里印出的数字。
